The '''SJ-4 Rapid Geoanalysis Scout''' was a prototype [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] model produced by [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Members of GSI were using these speeders to study geomagnetic pulses beneath the surface of [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] shortly before the [[Invasion of Ziost|eradication of all life on the planet]] in [[3636 BBY]].<ref name="dead pulse">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=daily|Dead Pulse|[[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The SJ-4 Rapid Geoanalysis Scout appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' during the mission "Dead Pulse" on Ziost.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
